prompt:
Edit the attached technical drawing with ONE localized artistic refinement. The existing red charcoal marks are too timid and look like mechanical pencil filling. Replace those marks with a few confident, tasteful RED BRUSH-PEN GESTURES that visibly feel like an engineer's spontaneous artistic flourish.
Preserve the complete technical drawing unchanged: layout, grills, food, charcoal positions, fine black hatching, all gray construction guides and projections, section marks, plan views, every Spanish label and the existing heat arrows.
Within and immediately above each of the three charcoal clusters in the MAIN views only (one central pile on the left, two side baskets on the right), add 2–3 expressive dark brick-red brush strokes. Variable stroke width: a small saturated ink pool at the base, tapering to a fine curved tip. Some broken dry-brush edges and tiny white paper gaps. A small translucent rusty-red ink wash can connect two adjacent charcoal faces. Include one or two SHORT calligraphic ember flicks that curl just above each coal pile, suggesting warmth and a tiny stylized lick of flame, never higher than one charcoal chunk. Clearly hand-painted and asymmetric, not repeating icons, not a digital gradient. Make this little artistic intervention legible at the full composition scale while retaining abundant white paper and crisp black charcoal outlines.
Red palette stays disciplined: dark Lumbre brick-red #7b251b with diluted lighter versions of the same pigment. NO orange or yellow, no glow, no smoky haze, no large flames, no sparks flying around, no red fill across the entire coal bed. Red accents should be a modest but unmistakable visual focal point. No fire near food, no marks in central drip tray, no alteration to heat arrows. Leave the food, metal apparatus, all text, margins and small plan views completely untouched.
Desired feeling: precise engineering notebook with one small witty, elegant brushwork flourish; sober, minimal, creative, not decorative excess. Preserve original white background and aspect ratio.
review: Pinceladas rojas más visibles y pequeños gestos curvos sobre brasas, sin alcanzar alimento. Se conservan esquema, texto, construcción y vistas en planta. Pendiente selección del usuario.
